name: SDLPoP
description:
SDLPoP is an open-source port of the original Prince of Persia (1989), based on the disassembly of the classic DOS release. Written in C using SDL, it provides a faithful recreation with modern quality-of-life enhancements.

Features:
- Pixel-perfect recreation of original running, jumping, and sword-fighting physics
- Scalable high-resolution display rendering with aspect ratio preservation
- Quick save and quick load states for practice and speedrunning
- Rewind functionality allowing players to step back in time after fatal mistakes
- Full modern gamepad support alongside classic keyboard controls
